scope: All 24 synthetic GTVs in the original GTV-only plan. Same recovered HDSS surface and fine input dose for both computed methods. Native TPS is a comparator, not analytical truth.
plane_method: Actual 1-mm CT planes, 0.025-mm XY sampling, area times 1-mm thickness; trilinear dose
hdss_method: Existing dose-grid centres inside the fixed unsmoothed MC0.5 surface; complete cell weights
